revision. Its selected tree contains no standalone grant. The main branch has

2. FAST-LIVO2 / VIKIT — FAST-LIVO2 copyright holders
FAST-LIVO2 selected ROS2 revision: 837b7bbc1431cb04cf936528e52c83c835efba8e.
VIKIT fork: f262533d04d99282ef63b2b3c8900eac71e6eafb.
Upstream issue: https://github.com/hku-mars/FAST-LIVO2/issues/413
FAST-LIVO2 states GPLv2; VIKIT inherits GPLv3 and compiles robust_cost.cpp with
an explicit GPLv3-or-later notice. The actual fastlivo_engine/mapping targets
link vikit_common, and inherited camera headers enter the engine. Please provide
a GPLv3-compatible grant for the FAST-LIVO2 contributions you control, or an
explicit applicable linking exception/other permission covering this combination.
The GPL license's example application notice is not treated as a project grant
of 'or later'. A BSD tag on a downstream VIKIT fork does not relicense inherited
code. Any permission must cover all relevant rightsholders, not only a maintainer.
